# Show a Block When Another Block Fails

A Command, Check or Finish block can show only while another block's latest run ended a certain way. Give it a `showWhenBlock` prop with the other block's `id` and a `status` (`success`, `warn` or `fail`, or a list of them):

```mdx
<Command
  id="rerun-plan"
  showWhenBlock={{ id: "check-plan", status: "fail" }}
  command="..."
/>
```

Until the other block has run, and while it is running, the block is hidden. A block that is running itself stays in view.

## Check the plan

The first run of this check fails. That shows the **Re-run the plan** block below it.

<Check
  id="check-plan"
  title="Check the plan"
  command='test "${PLAN_FIXED:-}" = 1'
  successMessage="The plan passed."
  failMessage="The plan failed. Re-run it below."
/>

<Command
  id="rerun-plan"
  title="Re-run the plan"
  description="Shown only while **Check the plan** has failed."
  showWhenBlock={{ id: "check-plan", status: "fail" }}
  command="export PLAN_FIXED=1"
/>

Once the plan is re-run, run **Check the plan** again. It passes, which hides **Re-run the plan** and shows the next step.

## Apply

<Command
  id="apply"
  title="Apply the plan"
  showWhenBlock={{ id: "check-plan", status: ["success", "warn"] }}
  command='echo "Applying"'
/>
